items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: They moved to Tulsa, and my mother, Alice, was the only one that had children which was of course us.

ctx.x: Well I was raised by my single parent mother. And there were three brothers and two sisters, right? I was number three in the rotation if you will. And I truly, you know, given recent news about Tulsa, Oklahoma, about conditions that took place during the race riots, okay? My mother had, all these years, had related to us that at eight years of age she had to drop out of school because of the loss of both parents in the same year. This was in

Southern Texas. And so she and her three sisters, elder sisters, she was the youngest of thirteen kids. They moved to Tulsa, and my mother, Alice, was the only one that had children which was of course us. And she — God I hate to say this — it’s very uncomfortable to say this but I never looked at my father in his eyes and said hello. Or who are you or what is this about. He was nowhere to be found. I think my older brothers, they knew him. They never talked about it. She never talked about it. And so she, when I…
Can I ask you what the going rate was for a shoeshine when you were doing that, and what would you get to maybe get a tip? What would you do?
